skill.displayName: AI Generated Perfect Female Body – Create Ideal Body Images Online – API-powered
skill.summary: AI generated perfect female body — transform a person photo into a bikini model image or video

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-generated-perfect-female-body skill.
- Transform a person photo into a bikini model image or video using WeShop OpenAPI.
- Supports API authorization via the WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Includes endpoints for starting jobs, polling status, and uploading images.
- Users can specify image, output type (video or image), scene description, and output count (1–16).
